catalogs.completeness_basis: Programs A-Z page of Catalog 2026-2027. Counted: every 'Major (B.x.)' entry, with one entry such as 'Dance Major (B.A./B.S.)' counted once, as listed and as records are keyed. That gives 152, plus 2 degree-completion entries counted anyway because unsure (Nursing Major (R.N. to B.S.N.) and Respiratory Therapy Major (RRT to BSRT)). Excluded: 7 Combined bachelor's+master's programs, A.A., graduate, certificates, minors and ROTC. The 130 verified records cover 130 of the 154; most of the unverified are B.Ed. teacher-education majors.
